name: The Forum at Olympia Parkway- Selma, Texas
summary: The Forum at Olympia Parkway is a premier open-air lifestyle center located at the intersection of Highway 1604 and I-35 in Northeast San Antonio. Featuring acres of shopping, dining, and services with convenient store-front parking, this accessible destination offers everything from apparel and furniture to beauty services and restaurants.
demographics: The Forum at Olympia Parkway serves a diverse suburban market in the rapidly growing Northeast San Antonio area, attracting middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes ranging from $60,000 to $100,000+. The primary trade area includes young professionals, growing families with children, and military personnel from nearby Joint Base San Antonio, with visitors typically ranging from 25-54 years old. The center draws from both Selma and surrounding communities along the I-35 and Highway 1604 corridors, appealing to convenience-focused shoppers seeking a mix of value retailers, dining options, and everyday services in an accessible open-air format.
description: The Forum at Olympia Parkway stands as a premier open-air shopping destination strategically located at the intersection of Highway 1604 and I-35 in Selma, Texas, on the thriving Northeast side of San Antonio. This quintessential lifestyle center offers visitors a comprehensive shopping experience with acres of premier restaurants, retail stores, and convenient store-front parking that makes every visit effortless. The center's open-air design creates an inviting atmosphere where shoppers can explore a diverse mix of apparel discounters, furniture shops, beauty services, and dining establishments all in one location. With its accessible location serving the rapidly growing communities of Northeast San Antonio, The Forum has become a go-to destination for families and professionals seeking both everyday necessities and leisure activities. Whether stopping by for a quick lunch, an afternoon of shopping, or an evening dinner, The Forum at Olympia Parkway delivers a complete retail experience that keeps visitors coming back time and again.
